title: Custom XML-Based Serialized Object Graph
pattern: Constructing custom, uncompiled XML/JSON string builders and parsers to serialize domain graphs into single database columns (LOBs).
why_bad: It defeats schema validation, breaks SQL query optimization on nested fields, and leads to massive over-fetching and serialization overhead.
detection: The presence of manual string formatting of XML or JSON tags to represent nested structures, stored as a blob in SQL tables.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. If communicating with a legacy system that demands XML payloads.
source: [The Addison-Wesley signature series] Martin Fowler - _Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture_ (2015_2002, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 10 "Serialized LOB".
